card.name: The word liquid in any setting
card.fires_on: The word "liquid" (or its first piece, "Liquid" or "L-iqu"), mainly as a modifier before a noun such as nitrogen, chromatography, hydrogen, effluent or light.

modes.label: Liquid before a noun
modes.description: "Liquid" modifies a following noun such as nitrogen, hydrogen, effluent or antiretroviral treatment.
modes.example: Its propulsion system will include<< liquid>> hydrogen and liquid oxygen.

modes.label: Liquid chromatography
modes.description: "Liquid" begins the lab method name liquid chromatography in test-interference notes.
modes.example: Use of mesalamine may lead to spuriously elevated test results when measuring urinary normetanephrine by<< liquid>> chromatography with electrochemical detection.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning state or phase, such as "state", "phase" and "chromat", which fit what follows "liquid".
card.plain: It lights up on the word "liquid" and helps predict phrases like liquid state, liquid phase or liquid chromatography.
